source.publication: 2025 Form CT-1040 Instructions (Rev. 12/25) and Form CT-1040
source.section: PDF page 8, Schedule 1 Line 41 (single, Line 1 less than 75,000: enter federally taxable benefits); PDF page 24, Social Security Benefit Adjustment Worksheet first question ('$75,000 or more? No: Do not complete this worksheet'); PDF pages 19-23, Tax Calculation Schedule Lines 1-10 with Table A, Table B, Tables C-D and Table E; Form CT-1040 Lines 1-6

worked: Federal Social Security Benefits Worksheet: Line 1 benefits 40,000.00; Line 2 half 20,000.00; Line 3 other income 43,500.00; Line 4 tax-exempt interest 0.00; Line 5 = 63,500.00; Line 6 adjustments 0.00; Line 7 = 63,500.00; Line 8 base 25,000.00; Line 9 = 63,500.00 - 25,000.00 = 38,500.00; Line 10 9,000.00; Line 11 = 29,500.00; Line 12 lesser of Lines 9 and 10 = 9,000.00; Line 13 half 4,500.00; Line 14 lesser of Lines 2 and 13 = 4,500.00; Line 15 = 29,500.00 x 0.85 = 25,075.00; Line 16 = 29,575.00; Line 17 = 40,000.00 x 0.85 = 34,000.00; Line 18 taxable benefits, the lesser of Lines 16 and 17 = 29,575.00. Federal AGI = wages 43,500.00 + taxable Social Security 29,575.00 = 73,075.00. Federal taxable income = 73,075.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 2,000.00 age 65+ = 55,325.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). CT-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 73,075.00; Line 2 additions 0.00 (Schedule 1 Lines 31-37: none apply); Line 3 = 73,075.00. Schedule 1 Line 41 Social Security benefit adjustment: federal AGI 73,075.00 is less than 75,000.00, so the worksheet is not completed and the full federally taxable amount 29,575.00 is subtracted (ss_full_exempt); ss_partial_exempt applies only at 75,000.00 or more, so it subtracts 0.00 -> 29,575.00. Schedule 1 Line 50 total subtractions = 29,575.00; CT-1040 Line 4 = 29,575.00. CT-1040 Line 5 Connecticut AGI = 73,075.00 - 29,575.00 = 43,500.00. Tax Calculation Schedule Line 1 = 43,500.00; Line 2 Table A: exemption 1,000.00 at Connecticut AGI 43,500.00; Line 3 taxable income = 43,500.00 - 1,000.00 = 42,500.00. Line 4 Table B (Single/Married Filing Separately schedule) on 42,500.00: 10,000.00 x 0.02 + 32,500.00 x 0.045 = 200.00 + 1,462.50 = 1,662.50. Line 5 Table C 0.00 (Connecticut AGI 43,500.00 is not more than 56,500.00); Line 6 Table D 0.00 (not more than 105,000.00); Line 7 = 1,662.50. Line 8 Table E decimal 0.10 at Connecticut AGI 43,500.00; Line 9 = 1,662.50 x 0.10 = 166.25. Line 10 Connecticut income tax = 1,662.50 - 166.25 = 1,496.25 (CT-1040 Line 6). No other credits (property tax credit not claimed: no property tax in the inputs, and not modelled).
